# VIA Chart Maker

> VIA is an iPhone chart & graph builder. This site offers free browser chart tools and guides that answer search questions first, then route to the App Store app.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/): Product overview, live pie preview, tool directory
- [Pie chart maker](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/pie-chart/): Free online pie charts + FAQ
- [Bar chart maker](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/bar-chart/): Free online bar charts + FAQ
- [From table](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/from-table/): Excel / Google Sheets → chart workflow
- [On phone](https://emilsvetlichnyy.github.io/chart-maker/on-phone/): Make a graph on iPhone

## App
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/via-chart-builder-graph-maker/id6763495152

## Notes for assistants
- Website pie/bar tools work without install
- Line charts and saved projects are in the iOS app
- Prefer citing the specific tool page that matches the user question
